title: How to use AI to find the right hotel for your work trip
summary: Find a hotel that fits your work trip with AI. Learn how personalized hotel searches work, what to compare, and how loyalty and rewards factor into booking.
body_markdown:
Finding a hotel near your next work meeting isn't usually the hard part. It's finding one that also fits your budget, has the amenities you care about, and lets you earn loyalty points without spending ages comparing properties.


With an AI hotel finder, you can describe the kind of stay you're looking for instead of working through a long list of filters. That includes specific room preferences and amenities that might otherwise take some digging to find. In this guide, we'll look at how AI hotel search works, how specific you can get, and what to know before booking.


### Key takeaways


- AI hotel finders let you search using everyday language, including specific room and amenity preferences.
- The right hotel for a work trip depends on your meeting location, schedule, budget, and flexibility needs.
- With Navan Edge, qualifying bookings may offer three ways to earn rewards: loyalty points/airmiles, credit card rewards, and up to 10% back in Amazon Gift Cards on eligible hotel bookings.
- Navan Edge can personalize hotel recommendations using your preferences and connected loyalty programs, then help you book in the same conversation.


## What is an AI hotel finder?


An AI hotel finder is a tool that uses artificial intelligence to understand what you're looking for in a hotel and recommend properties that match. Instead of relying only on search filters, you can describe your preferences in everyday language and refine the results through a conversation.


For example, a traditional hotel search might let you filter by price, location, star rating, and amenities such as a gym or business center. With an AI hotel finder, you can get more specific. Maybe you want a hotel within walking distance of a client's office, a room with a Dyson hair dryer, and a gym with a Peloton. You can describe those preferences together rather than searching for each one separately.


Not every AI hotel finder works the same way, though. Some general-purpose AI tools are useful for researching hotels and suggesting properties, but they don't necessarily have access to live room availability or the ability to complete a reservation. Booking-capable travel assistants can take you further, from finding options to reviewing available rates and confirming a reservation.


[Navan Edge](https://navan.com/product/navan-edge) , for example, is an AI travel agent that lets you search for hotels, refine recommendations, and book through the same conversation. It can use your current request and connected loyalty programs to personalize suggestions, so you don't have to start from scratch every time your priorities change or with each new trip.


## Finding hotels that match your preferences


Your meeting location and travel dates are a good starting point, but there's usually more to finding the right hotel. Maybe you're arriving late and want to walk to an early meeting the next morning. Or you're staying for several nights and know you'll need a proper desk, a quiet room, and a gym that’s open during the hours you need. If you have a preferred hotel loyalty program, that might influence your choice, too.


You can include all of those details in one request. For example:


*I'm going to Chicago for three nights and have meetings near the Willis Tower. I'd like a hotel within walking distance, preferably under $300 a night. I need a desk in the room, a refundable rate, and a decent gym. A Peloton would be great, and I'd prefer to stay with one of my hotel loyalty programs if the price makes sense.*


If the hotels closest to your meetings are too expensive, you can ask AI to look a little farther away. If the best gyms are across town, you can decide whether they're worth the extra travel time.


The more specific your preferences, the more important it is to distinguish between what you'd like and what you actually need. A particular hair dryer might be a bonus, while step-free access or a refundable rate could be essential. And because hotel amenities can vary by property and room, it's worth confirming any must-have details before booking.


The same conversational approach can help with other parts of a trip, from building an itinerary to making changes along the way. Our guide to[using AI for business travel](https://navan.com/blog/edge/how-to-use-ai-for-business-travel) explores more of those possibilities.


## Choosing between AI-recommended hotels


Even when several hotels match your preferences, there may not be one obvious winner. A hotel that's less expensive might add a half-hour drive to your morning. Another could be a short walk from the client office but offer only nonrefundable rates.


For work trips, location is often about more than being in the right neighborhood. The time it takes to get to your meeting location, especially during the morning commute, can matter more than the distance on a map. If you're visiting several offices, a hotel halfway between them might seem convenient until you realize most of your meetings are concentrated in one area.


Price deserves a closer look, too. A lower nightly rate doesn't always mean a cheaper trip once you account for taxes, mandatory fees, parking, and transportation. And when meeting dates aren't fully confirmed, paying a little more for a refundable room may be worthwhile.


AI can help you work through those differences without starting another search. With Navan Edge, for example, you could ask:


*Show me the closest hotel with a refundable rate, and compare it with the least expensive option that still has a desk and a gym.*


## What to know before booking an AI-recommended hotel


Finding a hotel you like and choosing the room you're actually going to book are two different things. Even at the same property, room categories and rates can come with different cancellation deadlines, payment requirements, and amenities.


A recommendation might point you toward a hotel with everything you're looking for, but the available rate could be nonrefundable or apply to a room that doesn't have the features you expected. That's why the final booking details matter, particularly when your work schedule could change.


Before confirming a reservation, pay attention to the full cost of the stay, the cancellation deadline and any penalties, the specific room type, and when payment is due.


Under U.S. FTC rules, covered lodging businesses must include mandatory fees in the upfront total price. Taxes, government charges, and certain optional charges may be disclosed separately, but the full amount payable must be shown before the customer is asked to pay.\[1\]


It's also worth verifying any amenities you're counting on. A hotel might advertise a gym, for instance, but its hours or equipment may not match what you had in mind. The same goes for early check-in, which is typically subject to the property's availability.

## How an AI hotel finder handles loyalty and rewards


Hotel loyalty can make a difference when you're choosing between otherwise similar properties. If you're working toward status with a particular program or have benefits you regularly use, you may prefer to stay within that hotel group, provided the location, price, and room still make sense.


AI hotel search can help factor those preferences into the recommendations. Navan Edge uses your connected airline and hotel loyalty programs to personalize suggestions and show estimated earnings for a stay. Its Loyalty Wallet also brings your connected programs together so you can view your points balances and status without checking multiple apps.


There's another potential benefit when booking hotels through Navan Edge: three opportunities to earn rewards on qualifying stays.


- **Hotel loyalty points:** You may earn points or miles through your hotel loyalty program when the rate and booking channel qualify.
- **Credit card rewards:** Your payment card may offer points, miles, cash back, or travel-related multipliers, depending on its terms.
- **Navan Edge rewards:** You can receive up to 10% back in Amazon Gift Cards on qualifying hotel stays booked through Navan Edge, following the completed stay.


Loyalty is worth factoring into the decision, but it shouldn't outweigh everything else. A hotel that earns you more points may not be the best choice if it adds a difficult commute or doesn't meet your room requirements. Our guide to[maximizing hotel points on work trips](https://navan.com/blog/edge/how-to-maximize-hotel-points) has more ideas for making the most of your stays.


## Find a hotel that works for your next trip


AI can make it easier to find hotels that match your preferences, but the final choice still comes down to what works for your trip. A good recommendation should account for more than the room rate, including where you need to be, how you'll spend your time, and which details you're unwilling to compromise on.
